label: Zalando Partner Program
terms_note: Zalando Partner Program (brands) or Connected Retail (physical retailers) — admission by application / invitation, fashion-only, EU markets; zDirect Portal apps with OAuth 2.0 client credentials; sandbox; integrators (Tradebyte, ChannelEngine …) commonly used; rate limits not public.

discovery.auth: oauth2 client credentials (apps registered in the zDirect Portal › Applications; per search-indexed docs)

auth: 1. Brand / retailer is accepted into the Partner Program and receives a zDirect invitation.
2. Register an application in the zDirect Portal › Applications → client id + secret; set access permissions.
3. client_credentials token → API calls; sandbox first.

endpoints.call: offers block / unblock · sales channels · logistic centres

endpoints.purpose: order retrieval, shipment confirmation with tracking, returns

reference.limits: Not public. - Partner Program admission (fashion brands / retailers, EU). - zDirect Portal app registration; sandbox environment.
mcp_sdk: none official found in the pages opened

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Client ID of an app registered in the zDirect (Zalando Partner) portal > Applications, with the stocks, prices, orders and offer-blocker scopes granted.

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: Client secret of the same app; sent with the client ID as HTTP Basic on POST https://api.merchants.zalando.com/auth/token.

config_fields.name: merchant_id
config_fields.help: Your zDirect merchant id (uuid; GET /auth/me lists the merchant ids the token can access).

config_fields.name: sales_channel_id
config_fields.help: Sales channel id (uuid) the offers belong to (Sales Channels API); each Zalando country shop is a channel.

config_fields.name: currency
config_fields.help: ISO currency of the sales channel, e.g. EUR; required for update_listing.

adapter.terms: Zalando zDirect (Partner Program / Connected Retail) API — access is limited to approved Zalando partners. Offers are addressed by EAN per sales channel.

me.note: GET /auth/me: the token owner's scopes and the merchant ids it can access.

update_listing.note: Prices API POST /merchants/{merchant-id}/prices {product_prices: [{ean, sales_channel_id, regular_price: {amount, currency}}]} sets the LIVE regular price of the offer (listing_id = the article EAN) in the configured sales channel. Only the price is applied (`price` required). Answers 207 with a per-item status.

set_inventory.note: Stocks API POST /merchants/{merchant-id}/stocks {items: [{sales_channel_id, ean, quantity}]}: `sku` must be the article EAN (GTIN-13). Answers 207 with a per-item result.

end_listing.note: Article Availability (Offer Blocking) API: creates a pause blocker for the EAN in the configured sales channel with reason PAUSE_06 ('Other reasons'), taking the offer offline; delete the blocker (DELETE /offer-blockers) to reactivate. Needs the products/blockers/write scope.

list_orders.note: Orders API GET /merchants/{merchant-id}/orders?order_status(initial|approved|fulfilled)&created_after(ISO-8601)&page[number]&page[size] for the configured sales channel (JSON:API). `id` is the order id (uuid) used by mark_shipped; raw.attributes.order_number is the customer-facing number.

mark_shipped.note: PATCH /merchants/{merchant-id}/orders/{order-id} {data: {type: Order, id, attributes: {tracking_number}}} records the tracking number. Marking lines shipped is a separate per-order-line PATCH ({type: OrderLine, attributes: {status: shipped}}) that this tool does not make; `carrier` is not a field of the order.

not_offered.create_listing: Offers are created by onboarding products (Product Submission / Onboarding APIs with the category's attribute model per EAN) and then sending prices and stocks per sales channel; the vocabulary has no EAN attributes or product model.

evidence: probe: 6/6 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 3/5 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; names not found on the page: mark_shipped:data, set_inventory:items, update_listing:product_prices
